structured.answer: I'd pick option B, the single list. It's the only one where each row has a Hebrew label like "אשראי ואג"ח" or "כספי (שקלי)" and I could see tracks with almost no shares. A and C open with English "s&p 500" and only shares, and I'd ask my son or the bank before doing anything.

stuck.where: Top of the page, option A
stuck.why: It opens with 'עוקב מדד s&p 500' in English letters and rows of 'מניות 99%'. It felt like it wasn't for me and I nearly left.

stuck.where: Option A, small orange note at the end
stuck.why: The bond tracks ('אשראי ואג"ח') are hidden in a small orange footnote, after two screens of shares.
The first number I saw was '13.79% 3 שנים' and it pulled me in, but then the pale note says it's past returns that don't tell what will happen. I didn't know whether to trust it.
Couldn't tell what the ring shows. Had to match turquoise and yellow dots to the numbers written next to them.

used: Option B labels under the names: 'אשראי ואג"ח', 'כספי (שקלי)', 'מניות חו"ל'
Section headings א/ב/ג and the 'מומלץ' tag
The pale footnote in C saying the return is past and before fees
skimmed: The three intro bullets at the top (small grey)
Group headings inside A ('מניות', 'עוקב מדדי מניות')
The lower part of option C (fund sizes in מיליון/מיליארד)
skipped: The filter buttons 'במה הכסף מושקע' and 'מוצר'
The arrows at the end of each row
The link 'מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה'
unsure_meaning: The number in the 'קופה' column (13874 etc.)
The small clock icons next to the percents
מיליון / מיליארד ₪ in option C (what fund size means for me)
not_found: Anything comparing these to a bank deposit
Whether any track is guaranteed or can lose money
A plain sentence saying which track is safe like a deposit
Whether my bank's fees are too high

findings.what: Opens with English 's&p 500' and all-share tracks. A cautious saver feels it's not for her and leaves.
findings.where: Options A and C, first rows

findings.what: Bond and money-market tracks are buried in a small orange footnote
Every row repeats 'מניות', 'מט"ח', 'מהחיסכון', 'מההפקדות', dots and clock icons. You re-read them each time to find what's different.
Ring colours are matched to numbers written beside them; turquoise and yellow on black are hard to tell apart
Dark background with small pale grey text. The explanations and the note on past returns are hard to read.
findings.where: Intro bullets, section descriptions, bottom of C

findings.what: A big past-return number ('13.79%') is the first big figure you see and it sticks, though the note says it predicts nothing
Many rows of filter buttons full of unknown terms make the screen busy and worrying
No comparison with deposits and no word on risk or guarantees
